body:
I'd like to work on this.

When a window leaves fullscreen, the `display/window/size/window_width_override` / `window_height_override` values are not applied, so the restored window comes back at the non-overridden size instead of the one the project configured. That points at the exit-fullscreen path in `Window`/`DisplayServer` choosing the stored window size rather than re-running the same override logic the initial window setup uses.

My plan is to reproduce on a current build, factor the override handling so the enter- and exit-fullscreen paths share it, and keep the behaviour unchanged for projects that don't set overrides. Before I start: is the expectation that the override applies every time the window leaves fullscreen, or only on the first exit — since that changes whether this is a missing call or a stale state check? PR to follow.
